name: Large Millimeter Telescope Alfonso Serrano (LMT)
description: A 50 m single-dish millimeter-wave telescope at 4,850 m altitude on Sierra Negra, a Mexico-US project of INAOE and the University of Massachusetts Amherst.
highlights: First light observations were in June 2011 and it was named for Alfonso Serrano on 22 October 2012.
It is described as the world's largest single-aperture telescope in its frequency range (0.85 to 4 mm).
Its collecting area is 1,960 square metres.
